from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashChange(BaseModel):
    """Cash and cash equivalents reported for one company during the period covered."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name from the 10-Q filing")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The period covered, e.g., 'quarter ended March 31, 2025'")
    start_cash_amount: float | None = Field(description="Cash and cash equivalents at the start of the period (e.g., Dec 31, 2024)")
    start_cash_unit: str | None = Field(description="The unit of start cash amount: 'millions', 'thousands', 'dollars'")
    end_cash_amount: float | None = Field(description="Cash and cash equivalents at the end of the period (e.g., March 31, 2025)")
    end_cash_unit: str | None = Field(description="The unit of end cash amount: 'millions', 'thousands', 'dollars'")
    quote_start: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt showing the start cash balance")
    quote_end: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt showing the end cash balance")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_changes: list[CashChange]
